Cristiano Ronaldo's World Cup Journey Ends After Portugal's Exit

Cristiano Ronaldo's FIFA World Cup career has concluded following Portugal's 1-0 defeat to Spain in the Round of 16. The Portuguese star, who has never won a World Cup or reached a final, stated it was his last World Cup appearance. The loss marks the end of a significant chapter for one of football's most prominent figures.
